Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XIII OF 1970
CIVIL COURTS (SIND
AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1970
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This ordinance may be called Civil Courts (Sind Amendment ) Ordinance,
1970.

Amendment of article 4 of P.O. order no 2 of 1956

ORDINANCE XIII OF 1970
CIVIL COURTS (SIND
AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1970
2. Amendment of Article 4 of P.
O. Order No. 2 of 1956'‑In the Karachi Courts Order, 1956, in' Artice
4, for the existing clause (2), the following clause shall be substituted,
namely :‑
"(2) The Court of the
District Judge, Karachi, shall not have jurisdic tion in original civil suits
and proceedings wherein the subject‑matter exceeds fifty thousand
rupees."

Amendment of section 24 of W.P. Ordinance II of 1962

ORDINANCE XIII OF 1970
CIVIL COURTS (SIND
AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1970
3. Amendment of section 24 of W. P. Ordinance II of 1962.‑In
.the West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962, in section 24, in the proviso
to subsection (1) and in subsection (2‑A), for the words "twenty‑five
thousand", wherever occurring, the words "fifty thousand" shall
be substituted.
